name: Little War Game
author: Addicting Games
description:
Little War Game is a browser RTS game. In this retro-styled war and kingdom building game you'll build a base, raise an army and then send them out into the wilds to do your bidding. Choose from Knights, mages, catapults, and wolves then upgrade your army as the game goes on. Raid neighboring players for resources, conquer castles and lay waste to friends and strangers alike in this miniature version of a classic, old school war games.  This fun little 8-bit style game has it all! In fact, Little War Game also has some very extensive modding tools. You can make your own maps and custom game with the Little War Game map editor. Invite your friends into the fray and prove your superiority via battle. Fight for honor, fight for justice, acquire territory and move on.

Little War Game allows you to start your own custom rooms where you can invite friends, co-workers, family members, Tinder dates, your Uber driver, basically anyone you'd want to have a friendly nostalgic battle of the wits with. New maps are added on a regular basis and players who are logged in can get season skins like holiday lights and wreaths for their castles or cute costumes for their brutal warriors.

Come for the game, stay for the war, love the little: Little War Game!
